Lemma
[spatial scalar-curvature comparison for the standard solution] Source: cao-zhu 1. Claim 1 in the proof of Proposition 7.3.3\group Ricci Flow with Surgery There is a positive function $\omega :[0,\infty )\rightarrow [0,\infty )$ depending only on the initial metric and $\kappa $ such that \[ R(x,t)\leq R(y,t)\omega (R(y,t)d_{t}^{2}(x,y)) \] for all $x,y\in \mathbb {R}^{n}$, $t\in [0,T)$.
